## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/PlotClaimService.luau
purpose: Feature: Themed plots and plot claiming for multiplayer: build a bright central spawn plaza (stone tiles, a fountain, lamp posts, trees) with 6 plots arranged in a ring around it. Each plot has its own theme with distinct floor material, colors and 3-5 decoration props built from parts: Candy (pink/mint, lollipops), Lava (basalt + glowing neon cracks), Ice (glacier/ice, crystals), Jungle (grass, palm trees), Neon City (dark slate floor, neon strips), Desert (sand, cacti). No grey or default-colored parts anywhere: the conveyor rails, dropper bodies and pads take the plot's theme colors. Players spawn in the plaza and walk onto a glowing CLAIM gate at the front of an empty plot (BillboardGui 'Claim <Theme> Plot') to claim it; the plot then shows a sign with the owner's name, starts the dropper, and only the owner can use its pads. One plot per player; a player's plot is freed when they leave. If a player has not claimed within 20 seconds, auto-claim the nearest free plot for them so the loop always starts. -- ModuleScript with the server-authoritative claim logic. API: init(plots) registers the 6 plots, each with a gate, a theme and an owner. It connects each gate's Touched event, debounced per player, to claim(player, plot). claim() runs only if the player owns no plot and the plot is free. It sets plot.Owner, sets an Owner attribute, calls PlazaBuilder.setSign(plot, player.Name), hides the gate, calls Tycoon to start that player's dropper on that plot, and teleports the player to the plot front. It exposes getPlotOf(player) and isOwner(player, plot). Per player it runs task.delay(PlotThemes.CLAIM_TIMEOUT) and, if the player is still unclaimed and in the game, auto-claims the nearest free plot to the player's HumanoidRootPart (or the first free plot). It handles Players.PlayerRemoving by freeing the plot: stop the dropper, clear the sign, restore the gate, reset owner, and clean up that plot's cubes. It also loops Players:GetPlayers() once at startup. Bumps 'plots_claimed' and 'plot_assigned' on every claim, 'auto_claims' on timeout claims, and 'plots_released' on leave. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: plaza_built, themes_built, plots_claimed, auto_claims.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/PlotThemes.luau, ServerScriptService/PlazaBuilder.luau, ServerScriptService/Tycoon.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry

```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

### PriceBillboard.luau (World price tag on a buy pad / shop item (BillboardGui), green when affordable. Works in server Scripts.)
```luau
-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end
```

```luau
--!nonstrict
-- PlotClaimService: themed plot claiming, auto-claim after timeout, release on leave.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlotThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlazaBuilder = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlazaBuilder"))
local Tycoon = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Tycoon"))

local PlotClaimService = {}

local entries = {} -- list of plot entries
local claimedBy = {} -- [Player] = entry
local tycoons = {} -- [entry] = tycoon
local gateState = {} -- [entry] = { {inst, prop, value}, ... }
local busy = {} -- [Player] = true while claiming
local initialized = false

local function count(name, n)
	Telemetry.count(name, n or 1)
end

local function isFree(entry)
	return entry.Owner == nil
end

local function entryPosition(entry)
	local cf = entry.origin or entry.spawnCFrame
	if typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
		return cf.Position
	end
	return Vector3.zero
end

local function tycoonPlot(entry)
	return entry.data or entry.plotData or entry.plot or entry
end

-- Gate hide / restore -------------------------------------------------------
local function gateInstances(gate)
	local list = {}
	if not gate or not gate.Parent then
		return list
	end
	table.insert(list, gate)
	for _, d in gate:GetDescendants() do
		table.insert(list, d)
	end
	return list
end

local function hideGate(entry)
	local saved = {}
	for _, inst in gateInstances(entry.gate) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "Transparency", inst.Transparency })
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "CanTouch", inst.CanTouch })
			inst.Transparency = 1
			inst.CanTouch = false
		elseif inst:IsA("BillboardGui") or inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Light") then
			table.insert(saved, { inst, "Enabled", inst.Enabled })
			inst.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	gateState[entry] = saved
end

local function showGate(entry)
	local saved = gateState[entry]
	gateState[entry] = nil
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	for _, rec in saved do
		local inst = rec[1]
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			inst[rec[2]] = rec[3]
		end
	end
end

-- Claim / release -----------------------------------------------------------
local function teleportToPlot(player, entry)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local cf = entry.spawnCFrame
	if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then
		cf = entry.origin
	end
	if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then
		return
	end
	char:PivotTo(cf + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
end

local function claim(player, entry, auto)
	if not player or not player.Parent or not entry then
		return false
	end
	if claimedBy[player] or not isFree(entry) or busy[player] then
		return false
	end
	busy[player] = true
	entry.Owner = player
	claimedBy[player] = entry
	if entry.gate then
		entry.gate:SetAttribute("Owner", player.Name)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", entry.index or 0)

	pcall(PlazaBuilder.setSign, entry, player.Name, auto == true)
	hideGate(entry)

	local ok, t = pcall(Tycoon.new, player, tycoonPlot(entry))
	if ok then
		tycoons[entry] = t
	end
	teleportToPlot(player, entry)

	count("plots_claimed")
	count("plot_assigned")
	if auto then
		count("auto_claims")
	end
	busy[player] = nil
	return true
end

local function release(player)
	local entry = claimedBy[player]
	claimedBy[player] = nil
	busy[player] = nil
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	local t = tycoons[entry]
	tycoons[entry] = nil
	if t then
		pcall(function()
			t:destroy()
		end)
	end
	pcall(PlazaBuilder.setSign, entry, nil)
	showGate(entry)
	if entry.gate then
		entry.gate:SetAttribute("Owner", nil)
	end
	entry.Owner = nil
	count("plots_released")
end

local function nearestFree(player)
	local pos
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp then
		pos = hrp.Position
	end
	local best, bestDist
	for _, entry in entries do
		if isFree(entry) then
			if not pos then
				return entry
			end
			local d = (entryPosition(entry) - pos).Magnitude
			if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = entry, d
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function watchPlayer(player)
	task.delay(PlotThemes.CLAIM_TIMEOUT or 20, function()
		if player.Parent == Players and not claimedBy[player] then
			local entry = nearestFree(player)
			if entry then
				claim(player, entry, true)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function connectGate(entry)
	local gate = entry.gate
	if not gate then
		return
	end
	local function hook(part)
		part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if not isFree(entry) then
				return
			end
			local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if player then
				claim(player, entry, false)
			end
		end)
	end
	if gate:IsA("BasePart") then
		hook(gate)
	end
	for _, d in gate:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			hook(d)
		end
	end
end

-- Public API ----------------------------------------------------------------
function PlotClaimService.init(plots)
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true

	for i, p in ipairs(plots or {}) do
		p.index = p.index or i
		p.theme = p.theme or p.Theme or PlotThemes.getTheme(i)
		if typeof(p.origin) ~= "CFrame" then
			p.origin = (typeof(p.spawnCFrame) == "CFrame") and p.spawnCFrame or PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame(i)
		end
		p.gate = p.gate or p.Gate
		if not p.gate then
			local ok, g = pcall(PlazaBuilder.buildClaimGate, p.origin, p.theme)
			if ok then
				p.gate = g
			end
		end
		p.Owner = nil
		table.insert(entries, p)
		connectGate(p)
	end

	count("plaza_built")
	count("themes_built", #entries)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(release)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watchPlayer(player)
	end
end

function PlotClaimService.claim(player, plot)
	return claim(player, plot, false)
end

function PlotClaimService.getPlotOf(player)
	return claimedBy[player]
end

function PlotClaimService.isOwner(player, plot)
	if not player or not plot then
		return false
	end
	return claimedBy[player] == plot or plot.Owner == player
end

return PlotClaimService
```
